name: chainedemoji
title: Exhibit A: Untitled (Crying-Laughing Emoji)
blurb: a containment wing for the cursed Blender render deepseek flash 4.1 produced when @cee.wtf asked it for "a 3d model of the crying laughing emoji," which @octopodeeznuts.bsky.social's reply thread unanimously voted to kill. reconstructed here (low-poly, on purpose) behind full wall text, a padlock, and a chain you should not examine. asked for by @shimmermathlabs.com: put it in a museum, then chain it down in the museum, just in case.
